reviews.title: Impressed with this CPU
reviews.comment: I have been putting this through its paces with giant software builds, ML/AI tasks, and multiple docker services for the last few weeks and I have barely been able to touch its ceiling. The one exception was ollama without GPU, but that was expected. Paired with the ASUS Pro WS WRX80E-S and a SSD, the throughput of this processor is truly amazing.
reviews.author: M. Tucker Bradford
